clue.text: Sky successfully offloading one line to family

indicators.note: offloading one means a single copy of the letter is dropped from the word, leaving the rest

parts.note: to do something well is to do it successfully
kin are one's family or relatives

explanation.surface: A satellite broadcaster sheds a channel and gives it to relatives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'offloading one line' drops one of the two Ls from WELL, leaving WEL.
explanation.definitionFit: A poetic, archaic word for the vault of heaven or the upper air.

clue.text: Mammal, a second seen in small lake

indicators.note: seen in means the pieces appear inside the small lake

parts.note: wee is Scots for small

explanation.surface: An animal glimpsed briefly in a tiny lake.
explanation.definitionFit: A small carnivorous animal of the stoat family is a mammal.

clue.text: Bottle stunt, alas, going wrong — still worth a mention?

indicators.note: going wrong means the letters fall into disorder

explanation.surface: A failed bottle trick, sadly, though perhaps it merits a mention.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase introduces a final item that matters as much as the rest.

clue.text: Concealed malefactor bumping off leader

indicators.note: bumping off leader means killing the first letter

parts.note: a sinner is a wrongdoer

explanation.surface: A hidden villain killing the boss.
explanation.definitionFit: Private, hidden from view, internal.

clue.text: Thanks Air Corps securing room for runways

indicators.note: securing means the outer letters hold the other piece fast within them

parts.note: ta is informal British for thank you

explanation.surface: Gratitude to the air force for keeping space free for its airstrips.
explanation.definitionFit: Asphalt surfacing is the stuff airfield runways are laid with, so it stands for the strips themselves.

clue.text: A version of Cinerama — Hollywood stuff, inter alia

indicators.note: a version of something is that thing rearranged

explanation.surface: Cinerama, the wide-screen film process, as a kind of Hollywood thing among others.
explanation.definitionFit: Artefacts of American culture, of which Hollywood film is one example.

clue.text: Admits autumn is wild, involving trees initially undergoing necessary changes

indicators.note: wild means the letters are thrown about
initially means the first letter of the word trees

explanation.surface: Someone concedes autumn is untamed, with its trees changing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involving' brings T, from 'trees initially', into the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: A Latin tag meaning with the needed alterations made.

clue.text: Girl in church picked up stringed instrument

indicators.note: in a down clue, picked up means the word is read from the bottom upward

parts.note: a lyre is a stringed instrument

explanation.surface: A girl in a church lifts a harp.
explanation.definitionFit: A female first name, as with Cheryl Cole, so an example of a girl.

clue.text: Setter: one with art on the meagre side

parts.note: the setter refers to themself as me
A is one
sly means artful or crafty

explanation.surface: The setter's self-portrait: an artist whose output is rather thin.
explanation.definitionFit: Paltry or contemptibly small, so rather meagre.

clue.text: Father nursing wife with fruit

indicators.note: nursing means holding the other piece inside

parts.note: papa is father

explanation.surface: Dad looking after his wife with fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: Another name for the papaya, a tropical fruit.

clue.text: But it doesn't mean we'd love never having to see you again!

definitions.text: But it doesn't mean we'd love never having to see you again!

parts.words: But it doesn't mean we'd love never having to see you again!
parts.note: the proverb says being apart increases affection; the clue jokingly adds that this does not mean a permanent parting would be welcome

explanation.walkthrough: The proverb about distance and affection, pushed to its absurd extreme: if absence helps love, never seeing someone would be ideal. The clue denies it.
explanation.definitionFit: The saying claims that separation from someone strengthens one's love for them.

clue.text: Something that remains at the end of several months

definitions.meaning: a glowing fragment left in a dying fire

definitions.text: at the end of several months
definitions.meaning: September, November and December all close with these five letters

explanation.definitionFit: A glowing coal is the remnant of a fire, and the same letters end three month names.

clue.text: Appeal for help to attempt to limit setter's deceptive approach

indicators.note: to limit means the distress signal's letters hem in the setter's name

parts.note: SOS is the distress signal
Phi is the setter of this puzzle
a try is an attempt

explanation.surface: A cry for help to rein in the compiler's tricky methods.
explanation.walkthrough: Phi is the pseudonym of this puzzle's setter, so 'setter's' supplies the name, not ME.
explanation.definitionFit: Clever but misleading argument is a deceptive method of persuasion.

clue.text: Broad description of things for sale?

definitions.meaning: playfully, an adjective from goods held for sale, as 'leafy' comes from leaf

explanation.definitionFit: A broad, solidly built person is thickset; and goods for sale are stock, so the -Y adjective jokingly describes them.

clue.text: Legal personnel about to procure English vegetable

indicators.note: about means surrounding the next piece

parts.note: a court is the judge and officials of a tribunal
to get is to procure

explanation.surface: Lawyers set to acquire an English vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: The British name for a zucchini, a garden vegetable.

clue.text: Fish was circling river and most of ocean

indicators.note: circling means the word was goes around the next letter

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: most of means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: sea is a synonym for ocean

explanation.surface: A fish swam around a river and much of the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: A brightly coloured marine fish of rocky coasts, often a cleaner of other fish.

clue.text: Chunk cut down in study article

indicators.note: in means the trimmed piece goes inside the study word

parts.note: to con is to study or learn by heart

indicators.note: cut down means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a lump is a chunk

explanation.surface: A piece of a reduced study article.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chunk' is LUMP, cut down to LUM.
explanation.definitionFit: A regular newspaper feature or piece written by one writer is called by this name.

clue.text: Unknown figure to betray rising official

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means read from the bottom up

parts.note: Y is an algebraic unknown
to rat on is to betray

explanation.surface: An unidentified person turns traitor against an ascending official.
explanation.definitionFit: A legal officer who witnesses documents and signatures is an official.

clue.text: Position university maintained in figures

indicators.note: maintained in means held within the figures word

parts.note: stats are statistics, figures

explanation.surface: A university's ranking upheld in the statistics.
explanation.definitionFit: One's standing or rank in society is one's position.

clue.text: Second year will involve one getting different and strong

indicators.note: will involve means the outer pair hold the rest inside

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
new means different, fresh

explanation.surface: A sophomore will take on a newcomer and become different and tough.
explanation.definitionFit: Tough and muscular, with stringy sinews, means strong.

clue.text: Relative turning up in unpleasant spot, without hope, lacking love

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up means read from bottom to top
without here means outside, surrounding the next piece

parts.note: a wen is a cyst on the skin, an unpleasant spot

indicators.note: lacking means the following letter is removed

parts.note: taken as written
love is zero in tennis, so the letter O

explanation.surface: A relative who ends up in a nasty place, hopeless and unloved.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' means outside: WEN surrounds HPE (hope lacking love), and the whole turns up.
explanation.definitionFit: A brother's or sister's son is a family relative.

clue.text: Party at dam displaying strange character

parts.note: a weir is a low dam across a river
a do is a party

explanation.surface: A celebration at a dam with an odd person present.
explanation.definitionFit: An odd or eccentric person, informally.

clue.text: Educate, arranging the learning without a staple of education?

indicators.note: arranging means the letters are put in a new order
without means some letters of the pool are left out

parts.note: the three Rs (reading, writing, arithmetic) are the staples of education, so R

explanation.surface: Teaching by rearranging knowledge but missing a basic of schooling.
explanation.walkthrough: THE LEARNING less A and R gives the letters to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: To instruct or inform someone so they understand is to educate them.

clue.text: Lover in fine shiny fabric

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencil leads
lamé is a fabric woven with metallic thread

explanation.surface: A sweetheart dressed in fine glittering cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: An old flame is a former sweetheart, so the word means a lover.

clue.text: Delivery from miller left in square

indicators.note: in means the letter goes inside

parts.note: four is a square number, two times two

explanation.surface: A miller's delivery left in a town square.
explanation.definitionFit: Ground grain is what a miller produces and sends out.

clue.text: See 10
Intelligence of that woman will make you fade

parts.note: wit is intelligence or sharpness
her is the pronoun for that woman

explanation.surface: That woman's cleverness will make you shrink away.
explanation.definitionFit: To shrivel or lose freshness is to fade.

clue.text: Artwork mostly recent (one-quarter coloured)

indicators.note: mostly means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: fresh means recent

indicators.note: one-quarter means the first two of the eight letters of the word coloured

explanation.surface: A mostly new piece, a quarter of it painted.
explanation.definitionFit: A painting done on wet plaster is a kind of artwork.
